_comment: What people say first when you talk to them while high (lines: peak from Peaking, ego at Ego gone; trainers once beaten), and hints about Astrals that only come out when you are higher (hints: until you have seen the species). Each once per visit to the zone. People whose script already has its own high branch (ifIntox) are skipped.

banyan.peak: You are peaking. I can tell because you keep looking at your hands like they owe you money.
banyan.ego: Ego gone, hm? I remember mine. It left in 1994 and still sends a postcard now and then.

beach_vendor.peak: Water, balm, baggies. And a discount for you, because your face is doing something beautiful.
beach_vendor.ego: My friend, I am a vendor. You are a vendor. We are all selling water to the sea.

crab_raver.peak: You hear them now, right? Left claw on the kick, right claw on the snare. They never miss.

trail_yogi.peak: The fire is breathing. Do not worry. It has been doing that all along. You are only now polite enough to notice.

trail_juggler.peak: Count the balls. Go on. Seven? I only own three. Do not tell the other four.

trail_spinner.peak: The fire leaves letters in the air when I spin. Tonight it keeps writing your name. Spelled wrong.

chad_g.peak: Bro. Bro. Are hands supposed to have this many fingers? I counted eleven. Bro.

chad_j.peak: Bro. Bro. Are hands supposed to have this many fingers? I counted eleven. Bro.

chad_b.peak: Bro. Bro. Are hands supposed to have this many fingers? I counted eleven. Bro.

diabolo.peak: You hear it too, right? The track under the track. I have been trying to play that one for eleven years.

pit_vendor.peak: Everything is the same price. The price is just louder.

pit_spinner.peak: My poi are comets now. I am a small solar system. Small solar system to small solar system: do you have a coconut?

pit_local.peak: Every type hits two others hard... no. Every type is a colour. Stimulant is yellow. Downer is a long Sunday.

svetlana.peak: Your aura is very loud today. Please turn it down, I am charging other people for silence.
svetlana.ego: Ah. Now you see me as I really am. Please stop, it is very rude.

yurt_tourist.peak: I think I finally got my money's worth. I cannot feel my face, which I believe was the package.

yurt_acolyte.peak: Breathe in. Breathe out. Breathe sideways. Yes, like that. Nobody else can do that.

market_vendor.peak: For you, special price. For the other you, standing behind you, normal price.

market_lassi.peak: Lassi is a cloud you can hold. Drink it slowly. Clouds have feelings.

market_collector.peak: Oh, look at you. A proper Peaking. May I write you down? Hold still. Stop breathing. Thank you.
market_collector.ego: Ego gone! The rarest mood. I would put you in the notebook, but there is nobody there to put.

market_tuktuk.peak: Tuk-tuk is a spaceship, boss. Very cheap spaceship. Still only for press.

market_wook.peak: Brother. The subwoofer is breathing. We are all subwoofers. Some of us are just heavier.

road_guard.peak: Stop. Who goes there? Oh. It is you. Or it is me. Either way, carry on.

keta.peak: Steady as she goes, sailor. The ditch is rolling a bit tonight.
keta.ego: Permission to come aboard. Of what, I could not say.

ditch_wook.peak: The sea goes to the lake, the lake goes to the forest, the forest goes to my head. Float on.

raju.peak: Look at the omelette. Really look. It is looking back. That is how you know it is ready.
raju.ego: Ah. Ego gone. The five o'clock special: one egg, no you.

stall_local.peak: Raju's kitchen is all Organic and Downer. Or the kitchen is all of us. Pass the chilli.

stall_wook.peak: I have been waiting for this omelette since a previous life. Worth it.

sea_sadhu.peak: The sea is saying something. Mostly "shhh". Very good advice.

lake_yogi.peak: Float. Float more. You are doing it. That is not water, by the way.

lake_local.peak: The lake is glowing round the edges. That happens. Only to some people. Only on some nights.

darkpsy.peak: Now you see the trees. Now you hear the real tempo. It was always 190. Everything else is lying.
darkpsy.ego: No requests. Not even from you. Especially not from the you that is not there.

forest_wook.peak: My Downers are asleep. I am asleep. You are asleep. Nice to meet you all.

thicket_wook.peak: The bamboo is whispering. It says Mantequilla owes it money.

corridor_cop.peak: The torch beams have a face tonight. It winks at you, and rubs two fingers together, very gently.

chloe.peak: Wait, do not move, the light on you is insane. Can I post you? I will crop out your soul, it is a bit much.
chloe.ego: You do not have an ego? Babe. Do you know what I would pay for that?

cliff_sergeant.peak: Viewing fee is fifty rupees. For you, a hundred. You are seeing much more of it.

sunset_watcher.peak: You see it too? The colours behind the colours. That is the part nobody can fence off.

cliff_tourist.peak: The man in the uniform has a permit to charge for the sunset. I have a permit to cry at it. Mine is free.

baba.peak: Ah. Now you see the smoke the way the smoke sees you.
baba.ego: Good. Nobody home. Sit. That is the whole teaching. The rest is smoke.

cave_disciple.peak: Baba says the walls are listening. Tonight I believe him. Whisper.

promoter.peak: Peaking backstage? Bad for business. Good for merch. Smile, you are on the poster now.
promoter.ego: Nobody in there to sell to. Huh. So this is how the artists feel.

backstage_bar.peak: Artist prices for you tonight. You look like an artist. You look like several.

backstage_roadie.peak: I carry the speakers all night. Tonight they are carrying me. Feels fair.

elite_kick.peak: BOOM. That was me. BOOM. That was your heart. We are in sync now, no take-backs!
elite_kick.ego: No ego? More room for kick drum. I approve.

elite_bass.peak: Feel that in your teeth? That is not the bass. That is you, turning into the bass.

elite_hat.peak: Tss. Tss. Tss. Every tick is a tiny door. You keep walking through them. Rude, but brave.

elite_lead.peak: The melody is easier to hear from where you are now. Hum it back to me. No. Close.

council.peak: Hmmmmmm. The barefoot one is peaking. Note it in the minutes. Nobody give them a microphone.
council.ego: Hmmmmmm. Ego gone at the council table. Some of our members have waited years for that.

temple_water.peak: Peaking on the temple steps, very nice. Drink. No, all of it. Then thank me.
temple_water.ego: Nobody home? Fine. I am pouring the water in anyway.

temple_local.peak: Kick, bass, hat, lead. Heavy, wobbly, fast, clever. And you, tonight: shiny.

guest_host.peak: Rs 100 a nap. For you, Rs 100 a nap, and the room will stop spinning eventually.

booth_selector.peak: Every record in these crates is talking to you, right? Only listen to the B-sides.

villa_assistant.peak: Chloe wants the sunset to be "more sunset". I think I can see how now. I am scared.

beach_hippie.t: Banyan's leafy one? There are wild ones in the incense on this beach. They only come out for people who are peaking.

trail_yogi.t: Something with too many teeth lives in the incense on this trail. It only shows itself to people who are well and truly up.

pit_local.t: There is a little Astral made of blotter paper in the incense here. You only see it once you have licked enough of your own.

yurt_tourist.t: The guru says a frog made of patterns lives in the incense round the yurt. I have never seen it. I am told I am not high enough. I paid extra.

lake_local.t: And something lumpy sits in the incense on the shore. Only for people who are peaking, they say.

lake_sign.t: Scratched under the sign: "saw a jellyfish made of light over the water. 3 AM. had no ego at the time. 10/10."

forest_wook.t: A grinning thing lives in the forest's incense. It only comes out for people who are peaking. Bring water. It bites.

cave_sign.t: Scratched lower down: "The crystal frog sits slightly to the left of itself. Only when you are nobody."

sea_sadhu.t: When there is nobody left inside you, something in the water starts copying what you do. I have seen it twice. Once was me.
